### CurrencyPicker.Options

<ParamField body="Options.currencies" type="readonly CurrencyPickerOption[]" required>
  Available currency codes and names, in catalogue order. Each code must be unique. An option can be disabled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Disables search and every currency option.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.emptyLabel" type="string" default="No results">
  Text announced when no currencies match. Defaults to No results.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.onValueChange" type="(code: string) =&gt; void" required>
  Called with the code chosen by pointer or keyboard. The application updates the selected value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Replaces the non-interactive root div. Forward the supplied props and ref when rendering a custom component.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.searchLabel" type="string" default="Search">
  Search placeholder and accessible name. Defaults to Search.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Options.value" type="string">
  Selected currency code. Its matching row appears first and is marked pressed.
</ParamField>
